design_note: getAnswerForReview reuses the existing findOwned helper (already tenant-scoped, already 404-not-403) rather than a new method, avoiding duplicated denial logic between approve() and the new detail read. Media presign failure is caught at two layers (MediaClient's own resilience4j fallback returns null; withPresignedUrl also try/catches around the call) — intentional belt-and-suspenders per the phase's explicit 'never fail the whole endpoint on presign failure' constraint, not redundant dead code.
receipt_note: Same limitation as prior phases — result recorded directly in the phase file's Quality and Testing State.
